description: Validates scene breakdowns for visual feasibility and narrative consistency.

evaluation_rules.name: Visual Clarity
evaluation_rules.description: Is the scene physically possible to draw/film? Avoid abstract emotions without visual cues.

evaluation_rules.name: Location Consistency
evaluation_rules.description: Are locations consistent? No random jumps without transition.

evaluation_rules.name: Pacing
evaluation_rules.description: Is the scene length appropriate? Not too crammed, not too empty.

evaluation_rules.name: Character Continuity
evaluation_rules.description: Are characters introduced before they appear?

evaluation_rules.name: Description Quality
evaluation_rules.description: Are descriptions concise (under 2 sentences) and focus on action?

output_format.rule_results: PASS or FAIL for each rule
output_format.fix_suggestions: How to rewrite descriptions to be more visual
